summary: Replace scattered delivery markers with one typed outcome model
description: Second task after TG-MEDIA-RESULT-CONTRACT. Introduce a typed DeliveryOutcome that centralizes attempted/success/failure counts, handler-delivered state, and cleanup policy.
acceptance: Text, streaming, document, audio, video, TTS, image, and mixed deliveries update one typed outcome.
Success-only cleanup uses an explicit all-attempted-deliveries policy and preserves generation semantics.
No ad-hoc _hermes_handler_delivery_attempted or _hermes_handler_delivery_succeeded event attributes remain.
